_meta.framework: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills — Spanish Language Arts and Reading (SLAR)
_meta.reviewNote: Verified 2026-09-17 against TEA ch128a.pdf and cross-confirmed with Cornell LII. IMPORTANT: §128.7 is codified in ENGLISH with authentic Spanish examples embedded — it is not a Spanish-prose translation of the ELAR TEKS. There is NO 'cognados' student expectation in §128.7(b)(3); cognates appear only in the non-binding introduction (a)(6). False friends are covered as 'commonly confused terms' under (b)(3)(E).

standards.subject: slar
standards.summary: Use context within and beyond a sentence to determine the relevant meaning of unfamiliar or multiple-meaning words.

standards.subject: slar
standards.summary: Identify the meaning of and use words with affixes (such as -logía, -ificar, -ismo, -ista) and roots (such as audi, crono, foto, geo, terr).

standards.subject: slar
standards.summary: Differentiate between and use homographs, homophones, and commonly confused terms (such as porque/porqué, sino/si no, también/tan bien).
